## pb-ssh-response (C9 v0, 2026-10-22: physical-lab demo)
**Trigger:** called by recv-thehive-event through Execute Workflow (waited for), for a TheHive alert update whose tags newly include lib-config `response.approval.tag` (`approve:firewall-drop`): `details.tagChanges` added it, or (an `addTags` call, no tagChanges) `details.tags` has it.
**Inputs:** `{config: <lib-config>, recv_execution_id, event: {thehive_alert_id, actor (the event's top-level _createdBy), event_time_ms (its _createdAt), request_id, how}}`.
**Actions taken:** re-reads the alert and its comments (TheHive retry pattern, N8N-6.2) and checks the approval: by a user other than n8n@asox.local; the tag still on the alert; the kill switch; a proposal on the alert (pb-ssh-bruteforce's writeback line `- [asox-n8n response-proposal] <agent id> <srcip> firewall-drop 300`); no response sent for it yet (`[asox-n8n response] ...: sent` or `: unknown`); within `approval.window_s` (1 h) of the proposal. Then **lib-wazuh-active-response** (action execute: every guardrail again, the rate cap; dry_run builds the request only). Live and sent: tag `asox:response=firewall-drop` and custom field `containment-action` = `ip-blocked` on the alert, asox-metrics (lib-metrics-upsert, mode update) `t_contained` = Wazuh's answer time and `outcome` success; live and not sent: `outcome` failed; dry_run: no metrics. One comment: `[asox-n8n response] firewall-drop <srcip> on <agent> (<mode>): <sent | not sent | not sent (dry_run) | unknown>` with who approved and when, the request, Wazuh's answer, the revert time; or, for a failed check, `[asox-n8n response-refused] <code>` with the reason (once per code and alert), and nothing runs.
**Systems changed:** in live mode the agent named in the proposal (firewall-drop of the address, reverted by the manager after 300 s), TheHive (comment, tag, containment-action), Wazuh indexer (asox-metrics); in dry_run only the TheHive comment.
**Approval:** required: tag approve:firewall-drop by an analyst (interim for D-N5, demo).
**Owner:** n8n.
Result: `outcome` (sent / not_sent / unknown / dry_run / refused / ignore / failed), `code`, `reason`, `comment`, `thehive_update`, `metrics`. Never parks (failures are reported in the comment and the result). Error workflow: recv-n8n-error. Saves every execution.
